title: Rapid Long-distance Migration of RPA on Single Stranded DNA Occurs Through Intersegmental Transfer Utilizing Multivalent Interactions.
authors: Pangeni, Sushil; Biswas, Gargi; Kaushik, Vikas; Kuppa, Sahiti; Yang, Olivia; Lin, Chang-Ting; Mishra, Garima; Levy, Yaakov; Antony, Edwin; Ha, Taekjip
one_liner_zh: 该文结合单分子荧光、光镊和粗粒化分子动力学模拟，研究RPA在单链DNA上的长距离迁移机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象非TF-DNA。
abstract: Replication Protein A (RPA) is asingle strandedDNA(ssDNA)binding protein that coordinates diverse DNA metabolic processes including DNA replication, repair, and recombination. RPA is a heterotrimeric protein with six functional oligosaccharide/oligonucleotide (OB) domains and flexible linkers. Flexibility enables RPA to adopt multiple configurations andis thought to modulate its function. Here, usingsingle moleculeconfocal fluorescencemicroscopy combinedwith optical tweezers and coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations, we investigated the diffusional migration of single RPA molecules on ssDNA undertension.The diffusioncoefficientDis the highest (20,000nucleotides(2)/s) at 3pNtension and in 100 mMKCl and markedly decreases whentensionor salt concentrationincreases. We attribute the tension effect to intersegmental transfer which is hindered by DNA stretching and the salt effect to an increase in binding site size and interaction energy of RPA-ssDNA. Our integrative study allowed us to estimate the size and frequency of intersegmental transfer events that occur through transient bridging of distant sites on DNA by multiple binding sites on RPA. Interestingly, deletion of RPA trimeric core still allowed significant ssDNA binding although the reduced contact area made RPA 15-fold more mobile. Finally, we characterized the effect of RPA crowding on RPA migration. These findings reveal how the high affinity RPA-ssDNA interactions are remodeled to yield access, a key step in several DNA metabolic processes.
abstract_zh: 复制蛋白A（RPA）是一种单链DNA（ssDNA）结合蛋白，协调多种DNA代谢过程，包括DNA复制、修复和重组。RPA是一种异三聚体蛋白，具有六个功能性寡糖/寡核苷酸（OB）结构域和柔性连接区。柔性使RPA能够采用多种构象，并被认为调节其功能。在此，我们结合单分子共聚焦荧光显微镜、光镊和粗粒化分子动力学模拟，研究了在张力下单个RPA分子在ssDNA上的扩散迁移。扩散系数D在3pN张力和100 mM KCl条件下最高（20,000核苷酸(2)/秒），并随着张力或盐浓度的增加而显著降低。我们将张力效应归因于链间转移，该过程受DNA拉伸阻碍，而盐效应则归因于RPA-ssDNA结合位点大小和相互作用能的增加。我们的整合研究使我们能够估计通过RPA上多个结合位点对DNA上远距离位点的瞬时桥接而发生的链间转移事件的大小和频率。有趣的是，删除RPA三聚体核心仍允许显著的ssDNA结合，尽管接触面积减少使RPA的移动性提高了15倍。最后，我们表征了RPA拥挤对RPA迁移的影响。这些发现揭示了高亲和力RPA-ssDNA相互作用如何被重塑以产生可及性，这是多个DNA代谢过程中的关键步骤。
